dashboard_start.title: Dashboard opening
dashboard_start.text: Boss Key opens on one operating view for active pursuits. Rebid pressure, contractor follow-ups, and live-pursuit readiness all surface immediately instead of being buried across separate trackers.

contractor_detail.title: Contractor relationship view
contractor_detail.text: From there, the workflow moves into the contractor relationship record. Touchpoints, fit, and next follow-up stay tied to the actual pursuit story, so relationship management does not drift away from proposal operations.

pursuit_handoff.title: Pursuit handoff
pursuit_handoff.text: This is the handoff point. Boss Key creates the opportunity from the contractor record and carries the advised contractor forward into the workbench without duplicate setup.

capture_context.title: Workbench context
capture_context.text: The capture workbench opens with contractor context already attached. Relationship history and live pursuit execution stay connected inside the same operating file.

capture_completion.title: Workbench completion
capture_completion.text: Once the workbench is active, contacts and commercials can be filled in directly on the pursuit. The operator sees the pursuit kit and the consulting economics in one place.

dashboard_ready.title: Readiness return
dashboard_ready.text: Back on the dashboard, readiness confirms whether the pursuit is actually operational. That is the point of Boss Key: visible movement from relationship to execution to pilot-ready work.
